scripts.dev: npm run build:preload && concurrently "npm run dev:react" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.publish: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
scripts.build:preload: tsc electron/preload.ts --outDir dist --target ES2020 --module CommonJS --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('dist/preload.js')){fs.renameSync('dist/preload.js','dist/preload.cjs')}"
